canvasCardMissing: Change {index} uses card {card}, which is not on this canvas
canvasLineToItself: Change {index} connects a card to itself
canvasNoLine: Change {index} removes a line that doesn't exist: cards {source} and {target} are not connected
canvasNotInDocument: Canvas {canvas} can't go into this document: it is not in this project, or you can't read the document it belongs to
canvasTaskNotFound: Task {task} was not found, or you can't see it
canvasTooManyCards: A canvas holds at most {limit} cards
